data.name: Quality_GeneralNote
data.value: This tool can enhance, normalize and restore audio, but it cannot recover information that was already destroyed by bad recording or lossy compression.

data.name: Quality_LosslessTarget
data.value: A lossless target format avoids additional export loss but does not make a lossy source better than it is.

data.name: Warning_LossySource
data.value: The source is already lossy. Processing can improve sound, loudness and intelligibility but cannot fully restore lost details.

data.name: Warning_LowBitrateFormat
data.value: The source has a low bit rate ({0}). Processing can improve intelligibility or loudness, but compression detail remains lost.

data.name: Warning_LowSampleRateFormat
data.value: The source has a low sample rate ({0}). High frequencies and fine detail may already be limited.

data.name: Warning_PotentialClipping
data.value: The peak is very close to 0 dBFS. The material may be clipped or heavily limited; lost transients cannot be reliably restored.

data.name: Warning_LowHeadroom
data.value: The source has little headroom. Additional boosts should be used carefully.

data.name: Warning_VeryQuiet
data.value: The source is very quiet. Normalization can help, but it also raises existing noise.

data.name: Warning_AlreadyLoud
data.value: The source is already very loud. More compression or heavy boosting can increase artifacts.

data.name: AnalysisSummary_Excellent
data.value: The analysis does not show relevant technical warning signs.

data.name: AnalysisSummary_Good
data.value: The source looks mostly good, but individual points can still be worth checking.

data.name: AnalysisSummary_Caution
data.value: There are technical warning signs. Processing may help, but it should be applied carefully.

data.name: AnalysisSummary_Critical
data.value: The source has clear technical risks. Lost detail cannot be reliably restored.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_NoIssues_Message
data.value: The available data does not show clear warning signs. The score does not replace listening.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_LossySource_Message
data.value: The codec is probably lossy. Processing can improve tone and loudness, but it cannot recover lost detail.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_LowBitrate_Message
data.value: The bit rate is low. Compression artifacts will not disappear by exporting to FLAC or WAV.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_LowSampleRate_Message
data.value: The sample rate already limits possible high frequencies and fine detail in the source.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_PotentialClipping_Message
data.value: The peak is very close to 0 dBFS. Transients may already be damaged.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_LowHeadroom_Message
data.value: The source is close to the digital ceiling. Additional boosts should be used carefully.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_VeryQuiet_Message
data.value: Normalization can help, but it raises existing noise as well.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_AlreadyLoud_Message
data.value: More compression or heavy loudness boosting can increase artifacts.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_MonoSource_Message
data.value: The file is mono. That can be correct for speech, but should be checked deliberately for music.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_MultichannelSource_Message
data.value: The source contains more than stereo. Check after export whether channels were preserved or intentionally mixed.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_LossyTranscodingRisk_Message
data.value: Re-encoding lossy material to another lossy format can add artifacts. FLAC/WAV only preserve the processed result.

data.name: AnalysisFinding_AdvancedAnalysisRecommended_Message
data.value: Loudness and peak recommendations become more precise after running advanced analysis.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_LossySource
data.value: For lossy sources, normalize gently and treat a lossless target format as an editing or archive format only.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_LowBitrate
data.value: With low bit rate sources, avoid aggressive noise reduction or strong high-frequency boosts.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_LowSampleRate
data.value: Export with as little additional loss as possible, but do not expect restored high frequencies.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_PotentialClipping
data.value: Avoid heavy boosting. Use careful normalization and preferably save the processed result losslessly.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_LowHeadroom
data.value: Use a true-peak limit and leave some reserve to avoid creating new clipping.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_VeryQuiet
data.value: Normalize carefully and listen back to check whether noise became distractingly louder.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_AlreadyLoud
data.value: Avoid extra compression. A lossless export preserves the result but does not repair existing overprocessing.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_MonoSource
data.value: Mono is often appropriate for speech. For music, check whether the source was accidentally reduced to one channel.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_MultichannelSource
data.value: If multichannel audio matters, listen to the result by channel and use an export that preserves the channel count.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_LossyTranscodingRisk
data.value: Avoid unnecessary extra lossy exports. Prefer FLAC or WAV for intermediate files.

data.name: AnalysisRecommendation_AdvancedAnalysisRecommended
data.value: Run advanced analysis before deciding on stronger processing for critical material.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_AdvancedAnalysisNote
data.value: Loudness and peak recommendations become more accurate after running advanced analysis.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_Speech_Reason
data.value: Mono, low bit rate or low sample rate often points to speech or already limited material.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_Speech_Note
data.value: This can improve loudness and intelligibility, but it cannot replace lost recording detail.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_PodcastVoice_Reason
data.value: Mono, low bit rate or low sample rate often points to speech or voiceover material.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_PodcastVoice_Note
data.value: This preset smooths speech, gently reduces low-mid buildup and sibilance, and normalizes to a clear listening loudness.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_NoisySpeech_Reason
data.value: Limited speech sources often benefit from careful noise reduction and steadier speech loudness.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_NoisySpeech_Note
data.value: The cleanup stays conservative so the voice remains more natural and avoids a metallic character.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_LosslessHeadroom_Reason
data.value: Peak values near 0 dBFS need careful normalization and room against new clipping.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_LosslessHeadroom_Note
data.value: FLAC avoids additional export loss, but it does not repair existing clipping.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_StreamCopy_Title
data.value: Extract the audio track without re-encoding

data.name: ProfileAdvice_StreamCopy_Reason
data.value: The codec fits a known target container and can be copied without new compression.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_StreamCopy_Note
data.value: This is ideal when you only want to take the track out of the container.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_Everyday_Reason
data.value: The source has no clear warnings; AAC 256k is a good quality-to-size compromise.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_Everyday_Note
data.value: For further editing, FLAC or WAV remains the better intermediate format.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_Premiere_Reason
data.value: Video sources are most reliable for editing when prepared as 24-bit WAV at 48 kHz.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_Premiere_Note
data.value: The file is larger, but stays editing-friendly and lossless after processing.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_MusicFlac_Reason
data.value: Music enhancement with FLAC is a safe starting point when the material is not clear-cut.

data.name: ProfileAdvice_MusicFlac_Note
data.value: This normalizes carefully and keeps the processed result without additional target compression.

data.name: ValidationSummary_Warning

data.name: ValidationSummary_Critical

data.name: Report_Disclaimer
data.value: This report describes technical measurements. It does not promise restoration of lost audio information and does not replace listening.

data.name: Report_NoValidation
data.value: No result check is available for this file.

data.name: Preset_Music_Description
data.value: Loudness normalization around -14 LUFS with a -1.5 dB true peak limit.

data.name: Preset_Music_QualityNote
data.value: For music, aggressive noise reduction is intentionally not enabled so that dynamics and tonal character are preserved.

data.name: Preset_Speech_Description
data.value: High-pass at 80 Hz, normalization around -16 LUFS and optional subtle speech processing.

data.name: Preset_Speech_QualityNote
data.value: For speech, intelligibility and loudness are prioritized. Compression and presence boost are intentionally moderate.

data.name: Preset_PodcastVoice_Description
data.value: Makes speech clearer with high-pass filtering, low-mid cleanup, presence boost, de-essing, gentle compression and -16 LUFS loudness.

data.name: Preset_PodcastVoice_QualityNote
data.value: For podcasts and voiceovers, speech is shaped to sound more finished without forcing hard compression or sharp highs.

data.name: Preset_NoisySpeech_Description
data.value: Cleans speech recordings carefully with high-pass filtering, light noise reduction, de-essing, compression and -16 LUFS loudness.

data.name: Preset_NoisySpeech_QualityNote
data.value: Noise reduction stays conservative so voices do not become metallic or artificial.

data.name: Preset_Noise_Description
data.value: Reduces background noise with afftdn. The strength is adjustable.

data.name: Preset_Noise_QualityNote
data.value: Too much noise reduction can sound metallic or artificial. Start conservative and check the result.

data.name: Preset_Copy_Description
data.value: Extracts the first audio stream without filters and without re-encoding, when the codec is sensibly copyable.

data.name: Preset_Copy_QualityNote
data.value: This option does not improve sound, but it avoids additional quality loss.

data.name: Preset_Archive_Description
data.value: Saves the processed audio track as FLAC.

data.name: Preset_Archive_QualityNote
data.value: FLAC is lossless but does not restore details that were already lost.

data.name: Preset_Everyday_Description
data.value: Exports to an everyday format with good quality at a sensible file size.

data.name: Preset_Everyday_QualityNote
data.value: For everyday exports, AAC 256k, MP3 320k or Opus 160k/192k are good choices.

data.name: ExportFormat_Wav24_Description
data.value: Uncompressed PCM at 24 bit. Very large but lossless after processing.

data.name: ExportFormat_Flac_Description
data.value: Lossless compression. Useful for archiving after processing.

data.name: ExportFormat_Premiere_Description
data.value: For video editing: WAV 24 bit at 48 kHz. Lossless after processing and compatible with Adobe Premiere Pro.

data.name: ExportFormat_Aac_Description
data.value: Good quality at a moderate file size.

data.name: ExportFormat_Opus160_Description
data.value: Efficient codec for small files at good quality.

data.name: ExportFormat_Opus192_Description
data.value: Efficient codec with more headroom for complex material.
